title: agent-core 0.7.31: T48 Mac-check fixes
head: t48-mac-fix
body:
**needs Braden**

## Summary
- Teams-send guard fires on person's own turn text before model or tool call, preventing premature read failures.
- Partial reads no longer leave 'couldn't read' standing when data was actually read; reports what was partial.
- Recap opening lines enforced in code: max 25 words, no headings, no count, no generic preamble.
- Chat auto-titles now require 2-4 words with at least 2 real subject words, skipping stopwords and filler.

## Mutation check

System-text rule (#73): no model-input assembly changed in this PR (the guard answers before any model call), so no system-message mutant applies.
